description: Find email addresses for a domain on Hunter.io. Returns the email pattern plus a list of professional/work emails with names, positions, departments, and confidence scores. Example: domain_search({ domain: "stripe.com" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Hunter.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

limit.description: Max number of emails to return (default 10, max 100)

type.description: Filter by email type: "personal" (named individuals) or "generic" (role addresses like info@)

name: domain_search
title: Domain Search
